# Project Constitution

This repository follows Spec-Driven Development (SDD) principles. The constitution records rules, principles, and amendment history used by SDD skills and workflows.

## Principles

### P001 - Write specs first

Always write a clear specification or characterization test that describes the desired behaviour before implementing features or refactors.

### P002 - Characterization tests protect behaviour

When refactoring, add characterization tests to document current behaviour and prevent regressions.
